goals.0: bevor, nachdem, während, sobald, bis — conjunctions of time
goals.3: Telling a story about waiting and appointments at the office
dialog.5.de.14.n: Plusquamperfekt: hatte vergessen = had already happened earlier
grammar.0.note: All are subordinate clauses: the verb goes right at the end. If the subordinate clause comes first, the main clause begins with the verb.
grammar.1.note: Plusquamperfekt = the past before the current past (“I had already done it”). Just put the haben/sein of the Perfekt into the Präteritum.
grammar.2.note: In speech Perfekt + Perfekt is often used; in writing the Plusquamperfekt adds clarity.
quiz.4.why: Subordinate clause: participle + hatte (at the end).
quiz.7.why: Subordinate clause first → verb first in the main clause.
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “While I was waiting, I checked my documents.”
